::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hyderabad firm offering silicon-proven analog, mixed-signal and IO IP, design porting and readout ICs (ROIC); has PDK access agreements with X-FAB and imec/Europractice.
:::

## What does this firm design?

ADCs and analog/mixed-signal IP, IO libraries, design porting and ROIC design.
